verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs claim real-time balances and transaction data on a native ledger, and a dedicated 'Webhook Events' API docs page exists, so the core real-time, event-driven elements are present. The pack only shows that page's title, so there is no detail on which events fire. missing for 10: evidence that balance reads reflect holds and pending activity, documentation that webhooks cover every transaction state change, details of the webhook registration and payload contract, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the ledger is real-time and event-driven — balance reads that reflect holds and pending activity, and webhooks for every transaction state change so my system mirrors the bank exactly

citations.quote: with real-time balances and transaction data
They run on a unified infrastructure and native ledger
